milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' means locate/observe the yellow wool in the scene. The yellow wool cluster is centered around (-4.5, 0.5, 8) relative to spawn. The player must navigate near it (within 16 blocks) and face toward it (within 60 degrees). This models 'the player has found and can see the yellow wool.'

Uses inventory_has because mining pink concrete with a pickaxe drops the block as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player must break at least 1 pink concrete block and pick up the drop. This is the standard rule for mine tasks — the mined item ends up in inventory.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') to verify decoration blocks were placed on or near the stone brick wall. The wall is at x=10 spanning z=-4 to z=4 and y=0 to y=4. We check a generous box around the wall face (x=7 to x=13, y=-1 to y=6, z=-6 to z=6) for at least 1 pink_concrete block placed as decoration. A second rule checks for at least 1 yellow_wool block in the same area. Both materials must be used to decorate the wall, matching the dependency on both prior tasks.
